title: Spices
sourceLines: -In the formula for the sacred oil Ex 25:6; 35:8
-Sent as a present by Jacob to Joseph Ge 43:11
-Presented by the Queen of Sheba to Solomon 1Ki 10:2,10
-Sold in the marketplaces of Tyre Eze 27:22
-Prepared for embalming the corpse of Jesus Mr 16:1; Lu 23:56; 24:1; Joh 19:39,40
